lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance local maxima; a primary horizontal row of larger-diameter blobs is flanked by parallel rows of smaller-diameter blobs, creating a structured 2D lattice.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular high-intensity blobs, defining a rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, prominent horizontal feature across the upper-mid flank characterized by a high-intensity upper boundary and a sharp, low-intensity shadow gradient immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower-left quadrant exhibits a high density of smaller, irregularly distributed high-luminance blobs; five vertical dark gill slits are visible on the right side of the frame with smaller spots on the intervening dermal folds.
